title: A Note for a Thoughtful Neighbor
context: Maya 想感谢邻居 Oliver 在她出差期间照看猫，请朋友 Lucas 帮她斟酌感谢卡内容。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I want to thank Oliver for looking after my cat while I was away.
dialogue.zh: 我想感谢 Oliver 在我外出期间照看我的猫。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: A handwritten note would be a thoughtful way to do that.
dialogue.zh: 写一张手写卡片会很有心意。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I have a card, but I'm not sure what to say.
dialogue.zh: 我有一张卡片，但不确定该写什么。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: You could mention exactly how he helped you.
dialogue.zh: 你可以具体写出他是怎么帮助你的。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: He fed Pepper and sent me a photo every evening.
dialogue.zh: 他每天晚上给 Pepper 喂食，还给我发照片。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: Tell him those photos helped you feel less worried.
dialogue.zh: 告诉他那些照片让你没那么担心。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I also want to say that Pepper was calm when I got home.
dialogue.zh: 我还想说，我回家时 Pepper 很平静。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: That's a lovely detail. It makes the note personal.
dialogue.zh: 这个细节很好，会让卡片更有个人心意。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Should I write a long message?

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: It doesn't need to be long. A few sincere sentences are enough.
dialogue.zh: 不必很长。几句真诚的话就够了。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I'll write it tonight and leave it at his door tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚写好，明天放在他门口。

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.en: He'll appreciate hearing how much his help meant to you.
dialogue.zh: 他会很高兴知道他的帮助对你有多重要。

expressions.example: Could you look after my plants this weekend?
My sister collected my mail while I was away.

expressions.en: be not sure what to say
expressions.example: I wasn't sure what to say when she thanked me.
He pointed out a detail I had missed.
Your kind message meant a lot to me.

pronunciation: thank 的开头是清辅音 /θ/，舌尖轻触上下齿之间送气；sincere 重读第二音节 SEER。

practice.title: Part 1 · Thanking people
practice.prompt: How do you usually thank someone who helps you?
practice.answer: I usually thank them in person and explain what their help meant to me. For a bigger favor, I sometimes write a short note.

practice.title: Part 2 · A thank-you message
practice.prompt: Describe a time you thanked someone in writing. Say who the person was, what they did, and what you wrote.
practice.answer: I wrote a card to my neighbor after he looked after my cat during a work trip. He fed her every evening and sent me photos, so I knew she was doing well. In the card I thanked him for taking the time to help and said the photos made me feel less worried. I left it at his door when I returned. He later told me he was happy to help. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Showing appreciation
practice.prompt: Why might a written thank-you message be meaningful?
practice.answer: It gives the writer time to explain a specific reason for being grateful. The reader can also keep the message and return to it later, although a spoken thank you can be meaningful too.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读讨论卡片内容的对话，再口头写出给照看宠物的邻居的感谢。
practice.answer: Thank you for looking after Pepper while I was away. The photos you sent helped me feel less worried. Your help meant a lot to me.
